title: Bouncy particle sampler with infinite exchanging parallel tempering
abstract: arXiv:2509.02003v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Markov chain Monte Carlo is one of the most useful tools for obtaining samples from complex distributions, such as posterior distributions in Bayesian inference. Bouncy particle sampler (BPS) is a method that performs sampling using uniform linear motion and elastic collisions. Since BPS does not require time discretization, it is expected to be more advantageous than the widely used Hamiltonian Monte Carlo (HMC) and Langevin Monte Carlo (LMC) for distributions with large curvature changes. To sample more efficiently from multimodal distributions, we propose BPS with parallel tempering (BPS-PT) in the infinite exchange limit, based on LMC-PT with the infinite exchange rate proposed in a previous study. Using a distribution with large curvature changes, BPS-PT showed estimation accuracy comparable to HMC-PT and LMC-PT, and achieved higher ESS per computational time. translated_title: 具有无限交换并行回火的弹跳粒子采样器
translated_abstract: 马尔可夫链蒙特卡罗（MCMC）是从复杂分布（如贝叶斯推断中的后验分布）中获取样本的最有用工具之一。弹跳粒子采样器（BPS）是一种利用匀速直线运动和弹性碰撞进行采样的方法。由于BPS不需要时间离散化，预期它在处理曲率变化较大的分布时，比广泛使用的哈密顿蒙特卡罗（HMC）和朗之万蒙特卡罗（LMC）更具优势。为了更高效地从多峰分布中采样，我们基于先前研究提出的具有无限交换速率的LMC-PT，提出了无限交换极限下的并行回火弹跳粒子采样器（BPS-PT）。在曲率变化较大的分布上进行测试时，BPS-PT展现出与HMC-PT和LMC-PT相当的估计精度，并且在单位计算时间内获得了更高的有效样本量（ESS）。因此，可以认为BPS-PT对此类分布的采样是有效的。
tldr: 本文提出了无限交换极限下的并行回火弹跳粒子采样器（BPS-PT），在曲率变化较大的分布上实现了与HMC-PT和LMC-PT相当的估计精度，同时单位计算时间的有效样本量更高。
en_tdlr: We propose a bouncy particle sampler with parallel tempering in the infinite exchange limit (BPS-PT), which achieves estimation accuracy comparable to HMC-PT and LMC-PT while attaining higher effective sample size per computational time on distributions with large curvature changes.
